# Leaflet 1.9.4

The map library for the route map (#54), shipped with the app so no other
site is asked for it. Copied unchanged from the npm package `leaflet@1.9.4`
(`dist/leaflet.js`, `dist/leaflet.css`). License: BSD 2-Clause (LICENSE).
The marker images are not included: the app draws its own markers.

To update: `npm pack leaflet@<version>`, copy the same two files and the
license, and update the version here and in `tests/page.test.js`.
